content: BERT can explicitly model the relationship of a pair of texts, which has shown to be beneficial to many pair-wise natural language understanding tasks. In order to fully leverage gloss information, we propose GlossBERT to construct context-gloss pairs from all possible senses of the target word in WordNet, thus treating WSD task as a sentence-pair classification problem.
